meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed both model wire adapters, single bounded identical inference retry, original deadlines and budgets, no tool replay or cross-provider continuation, dual-protocol regression fixtures.

auth.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and session authorization; existing server actor ownership and CSRF remain enforced, no auth implementation changes.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed unchanged endpoint pinning and authorization boundaries, private compatible transport loop, trace-only rejection metadata, canonical public knowledge URLs and existing storage.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed shared layout diff; no analytics tags, Google reporting or integration changes.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed shared request failure docs and backend skill; unavailable inference is an explicit saved agent error; HTTP boundary handler unchanged.

interface.review_note: Reviewed guest-mode notice and error copy; existing login, support and A2UI semantics remain intact.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController and SupportController changes; model form proposal never submits or queues mail; existing mail routes and abuse containment unchanged.

mcp-clients.review_note: Preserved the published four-key STDIO policy schema and enforce its key allowlist on invocation; native-only policy keys do not widen the connector.

media.review_note: Reviewed upload eligibility, revision hash, bounded UTF-8 metadata, row lock, exact patch, no row creation, and view/search/isolated DB tests.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed temporary provider-unavailability message, unchanged authentication and explicit user help behavior.

public-mcp.review_note: Verified existing public catalogue framing and published knowledge isolation; normalize UTF-8 media URLs before parsing while retaining safe path validation.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed shared layout diff; only guest support explanation changes, no cart checkout or payment behavior changes.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed MediaService metadata/search patch; URL, binary and usage fields used by published feeds remain unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed AGENTS and README constraints and generated maps; unchanged deployment workflow, provider recovery remains model-directed.
